screen34-a6.visible_text: "ATs" (initials on a rounded tile; three identical tiles in the rail)
screen34-a6.accessibility_text_consulted: content_desc "Accessibility Testin's server"; talkback_label (same) — used only to know what to watch for when tapping; not used in the verdict
screen34-a6.initial_rationale: three tiles carry the identical abbreviation 'ATs' and nothing else; a first-time user cannot tell what the tiles are or tell them apart
